domain: primes p congruent to 13 or 19 modulo 24; p=6m+1; m congruent to 2 or 3 modulo 4

frozen_parent_interface.R1: (A_m*J0-1)/p + A_m*J1 + F2*J0 congruent R_p modulo p

single_jet_object.specialization: b_{m,k}(epsilon) is exactly the k-th summand of Phi_m(m-epsilon/6,1/2)
single_jet_object.proof_note: The identities are exact termwise. The recurrence f_{k+1}(x)=f_k(x)(k-x)(k-2x)/(2(k+1)^2) propagates the value and first two x-derivatives. At x=m, k>2m has double Taylor vanishing, explaining why the first jet truncates automatically while the second jet must retain the task's cutoff k<=6m.

jacobi_base_value.derivation: Pfaff transformation gives _2F1(-m,-2m;1;z)=(1-z)^m P_m^{(0,m)}((1+z)/(1-z)); differentiate in z and set z=1/2.

reduced_certificates.a_m_jet: a = Phi/p - Phi_x/6, all derivatives evaluated at (x,z)=(m,1/2)
reduced_certificates.R1_jet_correction: (a*Psi-1)/p - a*Psi_x/6 + Phi_xx*Psi/72 congruent R_p modulo p
reduced_certificates.equivalence: The single mod-p^2 certificate is exactly equivalent to the frozen parent pair R0+R1.

prior_art_boundary.clausen_interface: If F(z)={}_2F1(1/6,1/3;1;z), Clausen gives F(z)^2={}_3F2(1/3,2/3,1/2;1,1;z), and F(z)(F(z)+12zF'(z))=(1+6z d/dz)F(z)^2. At z=1/2 the coefficients are (6n+1) binom(2n,n)^2 binom(3n,n)/216^n.
prior_art_boundary.identified_conjecture: Zhi-Wei Sun, Open Conjectures on Congruences, arXiv:0911.5665, Conjecture A14(ii): (1/p^a) times the weighted 216-series is congruent to (p^a/3) modulo p^2.
prior_art_boundary.plus_class_specialization: For p congruent to 13 or 19 modulo 24, (p/3)=1; the a=1 specialization predicts the weighted truncation is p modulo p^3.
prior_art_boundary.R0_boundary: R0 is the first mod-p^2 digit of that weighted supercongruence after the frozen Clausen-tail identification.
prior_art_boundary.R0_R1_boundary: R0+R1 recover the full mod-p^3 plus-class specialization after the already-frozen reflected tail correction.
contrast_sources: Guo-Shuai Mao, arXiv:1910.00779 proves a different 256 central-binomial-cube supercongruence
Zhi-Hong Sun and Dongxi Ye, arXiv:2408.09776 treats other Beukers-method supercongruence families; no exact weighted 216 theorem was located in the audited material
Qing-Hu Hou and Zhi-Wei Sun, arXiv:2604.15172 develops WZ derivative evaluations for other series; it does not supply the required all-prime weighted 216 congruence in the audited abstract/material

closed_exactly: All five frozen harmonic/block coefficients are the x-jet of one terminating hypergeometric polynomial.
The parent pair R0+R1 is equivalent to one mod-p^2 Jacobi-jet certificate.
The zero-order objects F0,J0 are explicit Jacobi polynomial values at x=3.
The inherited weighted target is identified precisely with the plus-class a=1 specialization of Sun A14(ii), preventing accidental use of a conjecture as a proved theorem.
unresolved: No all-prime proof or counterexample of the single Jacobi-jet certificate was obtained.
In particular, R0 is not promoted to theorem merely from finite regression.
R1 remains coupled to the frozen reflected scalar R_p through the second x-jet.
smallest_successor: Prove the single terminating Jacobi-jet mod-p^2 certificate, preferably by a finite WZ/creative-microscoping certificate or a Frobenius/Jacobi-sum transversality theorem at the supersingular point z=1/2; do not reopen Clausen-tail bookkeeping.
no_claims: no all-prime proof of Sun A14(ii)
no all-prime proof of R0 or R1
no finite regression promoted to theorem
